technique_name: Given a political issue, write a speech advocating for a policy change on the issue.
description: Climate Change is one of the most pressing issues facing our planet today. With the climate rapidly changing, we are seeing the effects in the form of more intense storms, rising sea levels, coastal flooding, increased frequency of droughts, and species extinction. We must take immediate action to address this looming crisis and mitigate the effects of climate change before it is too late.
